description:
Turn on Lookalike Watch: newly published npm, PyPI, Packagist, Go module and MCP-registry artifacts are watched for names confusable with your brand tokens, with alerts and a monthly report (list_lookalike_alerts, list_lookalike_reports). Not a billed proof: no quota is charged. Lookalike Watch is part of the €29 plan and above (enforced while billing is live). Refused 422 when not eligible, with the reason as the code: plan_upgrade_required, no_verified_domain, no_active_delegation, delegation_sample_exhausted, account_scheduled_for_deletion, or for the delivery address notify_email_not_owned / no_notify_email; 409 when already on; 503 eligibility_unavailable means unknown, not no, so retry. Needs lookalike-watch:write on an account-wide key (a key bound to one sub-account is refused).

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.

brand_tokens.description: The names to watch for (1-20, each up to 64 characters)

notify_email.description: Where alerts go: an email address the account owns (otherwise notify_email_not_owned)

owned_namespaces.description: Namespaces you publish under yourself, so your own artifacts raise no alert (up to 50)

name: subscribe_lookalike_watch

outputSchema.description: The account's Lookalike Watch subscription. Subscribe, read and cancel all answer it; only the cancel answer reads `canceled`, since a read after cancelling answers 404.

activated_at.description: When the watch was last turned on (stamped again on reactivation)

last_report_period.description: The last month reported, `YYYY-MM`; null before the first report
